request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

limitations: Synchronized per-context observation alters scheduling and is not a serving performance result.
Device counts include any graph padding; useful totals use host valid-token bounds after complete-routing checks.
Per-expert useful-row distribution is not isolated when a graph includes padded rows.
The two routed matrix products exclude activation, router, shared expert and other model work.
This run is not combined with r8 arithmetic or other runs' bandwidth/time to infer attainment.
